findings.summary: Deleting scripts/check-knowledge-map.mjs + knowledge-map-update.mjs orphans their test files __tests__/scripts/check-knowledge-map.test.ts + knowledge-map-update.test.ts (spawnSync the now-missing scripts). Must delete both test files in same PR.

FEATURE_MATRIX.md doc_refs (INV-112, check-feature-matrix.mjs validates File-not-found on disk) point at docs/DEVELOPMENT/REAL-PROJECT-TESTING.md (REQ-026) + docs/REFERENCE/RESILIENCE.md (REQ-051). Both are §WIKI-listed but deleting breaks the L2 gate (same precedent as dim-76 kept by #1243). Resolution: FLAG/KEEP both (removed from DELETE list, 66->64).

INV-56 hard-delete ripples __tests__/invariants/catalog.test.ts: count (118->117 x2), Tier5 governance (48->47), sequential-contiguity loop INV-01..82 (must skip 56 w/ retirement comment), and getFilteredInvariants counts (INV-56 target-facing/alwaysActive: TS-L3 74, Java-L2 69, Java-L3 70). Update all in green phase, test-driven. Leave ID gap (ID-STABILITY: never renumber).
gen-wiki.mjs collects source via git ls-files docs/. After deletions, full regen (not --changed) required to prune orphaned wiki pages, else wiki Lint-gate (INV-116) may flag orphans/stale.

CANONICAL_PATHS.md (INV-57 check-canonical-paths) has 4 recipe alias targets now deleted (B10-debug-mode, cost-optimized-phase-handoff, perf-debugging, sibling-worktree). Remove those alias rows in same PR.

Surviving docs + ADRs have [](path) markdown links to deleted files (check-doc-links INV-55, L2). Let the gate enumerate broken links post-delete; repoint to wiki/ or remove. Highest risk: PROCESS.md, TESTING.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, MILESTONES.md, REUSE_REGISTRY.md.
